data.name: Fathimah
data.gender_notes: Fathimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fathimah is an Arabic name for girls, derived from the word 'fatima' which means 'young girl' or 'little Fatima'. It is a variant of Fatima, the name of the Prophet Muhammad's youngest daughter. In Islamic tradition, Fatima is considered a symbol of purity and devotion, making Fathimah a popular name for Muslim girls. The name Fathimah carries the meaning “Young Girl, Little Fatima” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fathimah usually hope their child will grow to embody young girl, little fatima and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing purity and devotion in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Fathimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Girl, Little Fatima.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fathimah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فاطمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل فطم، بمعنى منتهية الفطام
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمة هو اسم علم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من الفعل فطم، ويعني منتهية الفطام، أو من فطمته أمه، أي التي فطمتها أمها وتربتها، وقد ورد ذكر اسم فاطمة في القرآن الكريم، في سورة آل عمران: ﴿وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ﴾، وترتبط فاطمة بنبي الإسلام محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، حيث كانت ابنته وابنته المفضلة لديه، وتعتبر فاطمة من أعظم الشخصيات في الإسلام، وهي رمز للعفة والطهارة والورع

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: فاطمہ کا مطلب ہے فطام سے مشتق، یعنی دودھ چھڑانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک معروف مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے فطام سے مشتق، یعنی دودھ چھڑانا، یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ فاطمہ بنت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی بیٹی تھیں، اور ان کی سب سے چھوٹی بیٹی جو ان کے بعد رھی، فاطمہ کا نام لینے والوں کو اسلامی تقویم میں عظیم مثالیں ملتی ہیں، جیسے کہ ان کی والدہ خدیجہ اور ان کی شادی علي بن ابی طالب سے

data.cultural_impact: Fathimah is a name deeply rooted in Islamic history and culture. Named after the Prophet Muhammad's beloved and virtuous daughter, Fatima, it holds a special place in the Muslim community. Fathimah is not only a name but a source of inspiration, representing the love, loyalty, and devotion of a father towards his daughter, as well as the heartfelt bond between a father and his child. It is also a reminder of one of the greatest figures in Islamic history and her virtuous qualities, such as patience, perseverance, and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: Fathimah, being named after the Prophet's beloved daughter, carries a deep spiritual significance for Muslims. Fatima is considered a paragon of faith, devotion, and service to God. Her life and teachings serve as a model for Muslims to emulate. The name Fathimah is a reminder of the Prophet's high regard for his daughter, and the importance of loving, caring for, and serving one's family, particularly one's parents. It underscores the value of faith, purity, and devotion, inspiring Muslim girls to aspire to these qualities throughout their lives.
